main.description: Declares a feed, in the repo of the account that publishes it. The record's AT-URI is the feed's identity. `did` names the feed generator service: the AppView resolves it to a DID document, finds its #authentiq_fg service endpoint and calls sh.authentiq.feed.getFeedSkeleton there. Mirrors app.bsky.feed.generator.

did.description: The feed generator service (did:web or did:plc).
